function createInputComponent({   label = "",   type = "text",   placeholder = "",   value = "",   onChange = () => {} } = {}) {   const container = document.createElement("div");   container.className = "input-component";    if (label) {     const labelElement = document.createElement("label");     labelElement.textContent = label;     container.appendChild(labelElement);   }    const inputElement = document.createElement("input");   inputElement.type = type;   inputElement.placeholder = placeholder;   inputElement.value = value;    inputElement.addEventListener("input", (event) => {     onChange(event.target.value);   });    container.appendChild(inputElement);   return container; }  export default createInputComponent;
